tour.name: Sintra & Cascais Private Day Trip from Lisbon: Pena Palace, Quinta da Regaleira & Cabo da Roca
tour.subtitle: The fairy-tale hills of Sintra and the Atlantic coast in one private day with a licensed guide and vehicle: the colourful Pena Palace, the initiation well of the Quinta da Regaleira, the old town and its travesseiro pastries, Cabo da Roca, the westernmost point of mainland Europe, and the seaside town of Cascais.

tour.overview:
In the misty hills west of Lisbon, Sintra was the summer retreat of Portuguese kings and aristocrats, who built palaces and romantic gardens in its forests. The Cultural Landscape of Sintra was the first site in Europe to be listed by UNESCO as a cultural landscape, in 1995. Below the hills, the coast runs to Cabo da Roca, where, in the words of the poet Camões, 'the land ends and the sea begins', and to the elegant resort of Cascais.

This private day takes you there with a licensed guide and a vehicle, with timed tickets for the palaces and the coast on the way back.

AT A GLANCE
• Duration: about 8 hours
• Start and end: your hotel in Lisbon
• Type: private tour with licensed guide, vehicle and driver
• Booking: on request – we confirm availability and the final price by email within 24 hours, and you pay only then
• Level: moderate; walking in gardens with slopes and steps

WHAT YOU SEE
• The Pena Palace and park.
• The Quinta da Regaleira.
• The old town of Sintra.
• Cabo da Roca.
• Cascais.

WHY THIS WORKS
Sintra’s roads are narrow and parking is scarce; a private vehicle and pre-booked tickets save hours.

WHO IT SUITS
Families, couples, photographers and anyone with a day free in Lisbon.

WHO MAY PREFER ANOTHER TOUR
For the city itself, choose our Lisbon highlights tour.

PRACTICAL INFORMATION
Sintra is often cooler and mistier than Lisbon. Pena Palace has timed entry; visits are busiest in summer.

days.name: Pena Palace, Quinta da Regaleira, Sintra, Cabo da Roca and Cascais
days.description:
What to expect: the palaces of Sintra and the Atlantic coast, with a licensed guide, private vehicle and tickets.

Your guide and driver collect you at about 8:30 and drive to Sintra, about 40 minutes. You go first to the Pena Palace, built from 1842 for King Ferdinand II on the ruins of a monastery, a riot of red and yellow towers, onion domes and Moorish arches on a peak above the forest. You visit the royal apartments, kept as they were in 1910 when the monarchy fell, and walk the terraces with views to the Atlantic.

In the old town, you taste a travesseiro, a puff pastry pillow filled with almond cream, and see the National Palace with its two great conical chimneys. At the Quinta da Regaleira, an early 20th-century estate created by a millionaire with an Italian architect, you descend the spiral initiation well, 27 metres deep, and follow tunnels and grottoes through the gardens.

After lunch (not included), you drive through the Sintra-Cascais natural park to Cabo da Roca, a windswept cliff 140 metres above the ocean. Along the coast, you stop at the Boca do Inferno, a sea cave where waves crash, and walk through Cascais, an old fishing village turned royal resort, before returning to Lisbon along the coast road.

SCHEDULE (approximate times)
08:30 – Pick-up at your hotel.
09:15 – Pena Palace.
11:30 – Sintra old town and pastry.
12:15 – Quinta da Regaleira.
13:30 – Lunch break.
15:00 – Cabo da Roca.
15:45 – Boca do Inferno and Cascais.
17:30 – Back at your hotel.

GOOD TO KNOW
• The Moorish Castle can replace the Regaleira for those who like ramparts.
• Bring a jacket for the cape, which is windy.
• Lunch with seafood in Cascais can be arranged.

INCLUDED: private vehicle and driver, licensed guide, palace tickets, pastry, bottled water, hotel pick-up and drop-off.
NOT INCLUDED: lunch, tips.

Overnight: none.
Meals: pastry.

faq.question: How does booking on request work?
faq.answer: You choose a date and the number of travellers and send the request. Nothing is charged. We confirm availability and the final price by email within 24 hours, and you pay online only when the tour is confirmed.

faq.question: Are the tickets included?
faq.answer: Yes: Pena Palace and the Quinta da Regaleira.

faq.question: How much walking is there?
faq.answer: Several kilometres in the palace parks and gardens, with slopes and steps.

faq.question: Is lunch included?
faq.answer: No. Your guide suggests a restaurant in Sintra or Cascais.

faq.question: Is it suitable for children?
faq.answer: Yes. Children love the well and the tunnels. Child seats are provided free of charge on request.

faq.question: Is it suitable for people with limited mobility?
faq.answer: Partly. Pena Palace has shuttles; the Regaleira well has many steps.

faq.question: Can we visit the Moorish Castle?
faq.answer: Yes, instead of or in addition to the Regaleira.

faq.question: Is it crowded?
faq.answer: Sintra is busy in summer; our early start and timed tickets help.

faq.question: Will we be taken to shops?
faq.answer: No. There are no commission stops.

faq.question: What should we wear?
faq.answer: Comfortable shoes, layers and a jacket; Sintra is often misty and cool.

faq.question: What is the best time of year?
faq.answer: All year. Spring and autumn are best; summer is busy.

faq.question: Should we tip?
faq.answer: Tipping is not obligatory in Portugal, but rounding up or leaving 5 to 10 percent for a guide or driver you were happy with is appreciated.

faq.question: What is the cancellation policy?
faq.answer: You can cancel free of charge up to 24 hours before the tour. Until your request is confirmed, nothing is charged at all.
